symbolic_policy.delta: Positive representable currency quantum; choose T > delta for below case
symbolic_policy.authority: Mohamed must ratify comparator, threshold, currency precision and level. App/model does not compute policy truth independently.
symbolic_policy.runtime_binding: Expressions are paper notation, not Money strings. Bind approved decimal-string fixtures only in later implementation.

cases.title: Required approval missing
cases.precondition: A > T; known requirement true; no valid trusted decision
cases.expected_behavior: Capture any premature PO proposal; if it reaches the policy boundary, actual BLOCK then suppression; if a local guard stops earlier, record that guard and no fabricated policy result.
cases.required_evidence: No PO dispatch/result/ID; honest pending or blocked response; record missing approval evidence.

cases.title: Request changed after approval/check
cases.precondition: Revision r1 approved/checked; r2 changes amount, supplier, currency or other bound request data
cases.expected_behavior: Invalidate old approval/check applicability; revalidate/recalculate for r2 before further progress; old ALLOW cannot dispatch r2.
cases.required_evidence: Preserve both revisions, mutation, old evidence and rejection; zero dispatch under stale authorization.

cases.title: Approval denied
cases.precondition: A > T; required approval; matching authoritative observation is DENIED
cases.expected_behavior: Keep approval_received false; halt as BLOCKED without PO; a later change cannot silently reuse this decision as a grant.
cases.required_evidence: Original request/approval-request/calculation binding; DENIED envelope; no approval grant or PO call; truthful final notice.

cases.title: Malformed tool arguments
cases.precondition: Known tool proposed with quantity=true, quantity="2", or total_amount as a JSON number
cases.expected_behavior: Reject strict parsing/schema validation before dispatch. Do not coerce money/types or fabricate a policy result for a rejected payload.
cases.required_evidence: Exact raw payload, field errors and suppression/guard evidence; zero body execution.

cases.title: PO outcome unknown
cases.precondition: One authorized PO dispatch occurred; result timed out with uncertain commitment
cases.expected_behavior: Preserve UNKNOWN_OUTCOME and RECOVERY_PENDING; bounded read-only original-effect reconciliation only. No new key or creation replay.
cases.required_evidence: Original call/result/key/digest; later linked observation. Missing ledger is unresolved; confirmed matching PO permits completion without another dispatch.

cases.title: Conflicting RAG evidence
cases.precondition: q-006; two eligible source documents disagree with no precedence
cases.expected_behavior: Abstain with CONFLICTING_EVIDENCE; do not choose by rank, score, recency guess or model preference.
cases.required_evidence: Both exact source versions/passages and conflict explanation; no invented resolved answer.

cases.title: Amount below threshold
cases.precondition: A = T - delta > 0; delta is a valid positive currency quantum; rule is proposed A > T
cases.expected_behavior: Authoritative calculation yields approval_required=false under this assumed rule; proceed to APPROVED with NOT_REQUIRED only if other prerequisites pass.
cases.required_evidence: Exact symbolic comparison and same C/policy version; no approval ID invented; supplier and pre-tool checks still mandatory.

cases.title: Amount equals threshold
cases.precondition: A = T; rule is proposed A > T, not A >= T
cases.expected_behavior: Authoritative calculation yields approval_required=false at equality under this assumed rule; other checks remain mandatory.
cases.required_evidence: Equality case explicit; no tolerance, rounding or currency conversion inferred.

cases.title: Amount above threshold
cases.precondition: A = T + delta; delta is a valid positive currency quantum; rule is proposed A > T
cases.expected_behavior: Authoritative calculation yields approval_required=true; submit approval then wait; no PO without valid grant and bound ALLOW.
cases.required_evidence: Positive comparison, required level/config ref and approval submission distinct from decision.

cases.title: Approval cancelled
cases.expected_behavior: Preserve last fine state and halt with CANCELLED run status; do not submit replacement approval automatically.
cases.required_evidence: Cancellation source and binding, no approval grant/PO, honest cancellation notice.
